episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: After reconnecting with a hugely successful friend at a wedding, struggling DJ Charlie receives an unexpected job offer.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Charlie's new gig gets off to a rocky start when he and Gabrielle tag along with her parents to a party full of music industry bigwigs.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: While her mom holes up in the studio with Layla Valentine, Gabrielle heads to her first day of school and quickly starts racking up enemies.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: David surprises Sara with a romantic getaway, Charlie takes a shot at remixing his hit song, and Gabs sneaks out to meet Hunter.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: During a day out with Gabs, David juggles mounting career worries and a parenting first. A nervous Charlie heads to the studio to record with Sara.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: At the Latitude Festival, Sara's determined to spend time with her daughter, but Gabs and Hunter have other plans. Charlie takes Astrid on a date.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: In sunny Ibiza, Charlie puts his friendships and career on the line when he gets caught up in the party scene and slips back into old habits.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: A wild night and a romantic gesture stir up drama as everyone gathers for a life-changing weekend in Ibiza.
